description.zh:
API KEY ID 列表。多个指标用英文半角“,”分隔。如果不传，默认是实例 ID 下所有的 API KEY ID。

> 列表项最多 50 个。
description.en:
The list of API key IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). If this parameter is not specified, all API key IDs under the instance ID are used by default.

> The list can contain up to 50 items.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，且开始时间和结束时间的时间间隔不能超过7天。
description.en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format (UTC). > The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed 7 days.

description.zh:
series 切分维度，用英文半角“,”分隔，顺序不敏感。取值如下：

- model（默认值）：按模型切分。
- api_key：按 apikey 切分。
- model,api_key：按模型、apikey 切分。
description.en:
The dimension by which to split the series. Separate multiple dimensions with commas (,). The order is not significant. Valid values:

- model (default): splits by model.
- api_key: splits by API key.
- model,api_key: splits by model and API key.

description.zh:
指标列表。多个指标用英文半角“,”分隔。取值如下：

- request_count：请求数。
- success_count：请求成功数。
- error_count：请求失败数。
- success_rate：请求成功率。
- input_token：输入 token 数。
- output_token：输出 token 数。
- total_token：总 token 数。
description.en:
The list of metrics. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Valid values:

- request_count: the number of requests.
- success_count: the number of successful requests.
- error_count: the number of failed requests.
- success_rate: the request success rate.
- input_token: the number of input tokens.
- output_token: the number of output tokens.
- total_token: the total number of tokens.

description.zh: 模型名称列表。多个指标用英文半角“,”分隔。
description.en: The list of model names. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

description.zh:
时间桶大小（秒）。取值在 {1, 5, 15, 60, 300, 3600} 内。

>
> - 1. 当Period 未传时，按如下规则选择默认值：
> - - 窗口范围 ≤ 1 小时，Period = 1。
> - - 窗口范围 ≤ 1 天，Period = 60。
> - - 窗口范围 ≤ 7 天，Period = 60。
> - 2. Period=1 时窗口必须 ≤1 天。
description.en:
The time bucket size in seconds. Valid values: 1, 5, 15, 60, 300, and 3600.

>
> - 1. If Period is not specified, the default value is determined by the following rules:
> - - Window range ≤ 1 hour: Period = 1.
> - - Window range ≤ 1 day: Period = 60.
> - - Window range ≤ 7 days: Period = 60.
> - 2. When Period is set to 1, the window must be ≤ 1 day.

description.zh: 查询开始时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 仅支持查询 30 天内的指标信息。
description.en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format (UTC). > Only metrics within the last 30 days can be queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-model-operator-usage --keys request_count,_success_count --start-time 2026-06-01T00:00Z --end-time 2026-06-02T00:00Z --api-key-ids 1 --model-names qwen3.6-plus --group-by model --period 1 --region cn-hangzhou
